name: 皇家园林经典文化线
audience: 初次到访、历史爱好者，愿意登高的游客
audience_en: First-time visitors and history lovers comfortable with stairs
summary: 从宫廷礼制走向山水园林，串联理政、起居、戏曲、彩画与登高观景，完整读懂颐和园。
summary_en: Connect court ceremony, royal living, theatre, painted galleries and hillside views for a fuller introduction to the Summer Palace.
tips: 佛香阁及万寿山登高区域台阶较多，建议穿防滑鞋；体力不足时，可在长廊后结束或调整行程。园中园开放、票务与排队情况以现场为准。
tips_en: The hillside and Tower of Buddhist Incense involve stairs. Wear suitable shoes; shorten the route after the Long Corridor if needed. Check access, tickets and queues on site.
stops: 仁寿殿
从殿前陈设和院落轴线认识皇家理政空间。
Read the court axis and forecourt furnishings as a setting for state affairs.
德和园
观察大戏楼与庭院的关系，理解宫廷观演活动。
Explore the theatre building and its relationship with the surrounding courtyards.
玉澜堂
结合院落布局了解帝后驻园时期的生活空间。
Use the courtyard layout to understand royal residential life.
乐寿堂
从生活起居转入临湖园林，留意庭院陈设。
Notice how residential courtyards connect to the lakeside garden.
长廊
选择几间彩画细看，再以廊柱框取湖景。
Study selected painted bays and frame lake views between the columns.
排云殿
沿院落与台阶认识前山建筑中轴。
Follow courtyards and steps to understand the front-hill architectural axis.
佛香阁
辨认登高后的湖、堤、桥与建筑层次。
Look for the lake, causeways, bridges and building layers from higher ground.
昆明湖
回到湖岸休整，以湖山关系收束游览。
Return to the shore and reflect on the relationship between lake and hill.

name: 昆明湖摄影漫游线
audience: 摄影爱好者、希望慢看湖岸风景的游客
audience_en: Photographers and visitors who enjoy an extended lakeside walk
summary: 以廊柱、石舫、拱桥和湖岸为画面线索，沿西侧湖岸转向桥岛与东岸，体验远景、倒影和建筑细节的变化。
summary_en: Follow gallery frames, the Marble Boat and arched bridges around the lake, moving from western shores to the island and eastern waterfront.
tips: 这是步行较长的摄影路线，建议预留半天并分段休息；南湖岛为往返支线，需要经十七孔桥返回。日照、倒影和拍摄条件受天气影响，不保证特定光影效果。
tips_en: Allow a half day with breaks for this longer photography walk. South Lake Island requires returning across the Seventeen-Arch Bridge. Light and reflections depend on conditions.
stops: 长廊
利用柱列透视拍摄人物或框取湖面。
Use column perspectives for portraits and framed lake views.
石舫
观察船形建筑的层次与临水倒影。
Study the boat-shaped building and its waterside reflections.
玉带桥
从岸边安全位置拍摄高拱与倒影。
Photograph the high arch and reflection from a safe shore position.
十七孔桥
在桥岸两端比较桥孔节奏与湖面背景。
Compare the rhythm of the arches and lake backdrop from the shore.
南湖岛
转向万寿山方向，寻找湖山远景层次。
Look toward Longevity Hill for layered views across the water.
铜牛
以铜牛与湖岸为前景，避免倚靠或触碰文物。
Use the ox and lakeshore as foreground elements without touching the sculpture.
文昌阁
以楼阁、岸线和水面关系结束摄影行程。
Finish with the pavilion, shoreline and water in one composition.

name: 亲子湖山体验线
audience: 亲子家庭、偏好院落与湖岸体验的游客
audience_en: Families and visitors who prefer courtyards and lakeside experiences
summary: 以看建筑、找图案、听故事为主，串联东部宫廷生活区和长廊湖岸，减少集中登高，把游览变成可停可看的观察游戏。
summary_en: Turn royal courtyards and the lakeside gallery into an observation trail, with stories, decorative patterns and pauses instead of a concentrated hill climb.
tips: 可让孩子每站挑选一种图案并说出发现；长廊之后留出休息时间。不把路线视为无障碍认证，推车通过、院落开放与现场拥挤情况仍需确认。
tips_en: Invite children to spot a motif at each stop and leave time for a lakeside break. This is not a certified accessible route; check stroller access, opening and crowd conditions locally.
stops: 仁寿殿
一起寻找殿前陈设，分辨建筑的正面与轴线。
Spot forecourt objects and identify the main building axis together.
德和园
看看戏楼有几层，讨论古人在哪里看戏。
Observe the theatre levels and discuss how an audience watched performances.
玉澜堂
观察窗棂和院落，比较不同空间的用途。
Compare lattice patterns and the uses of different courtyard spaces.
乐寿堂
从庭院陈设发现皇家生活的细节。
Discover details of royal daily life through courtyard furnishings.
长廊
挑选几间画面清楚的彩画，寻找花鸟山水。
Choose clear painted bays and look for flowers, birds and landscapes.
昆明湖
在允许停留的湖岸休息，复述今天最喜欢的发现。
Pause at an appropriate shore location and share favourite discoveries.

name: 后湖江南寻趣线
audience: 喜欢园林构景、水街与慢游的游客
audience_en: Visitors interested in waterside streets and intimate garden scenes
summary: 从苏州街的水镇意象出发，比较谐趣园的小尺度园景、宫廷院落与长廊湖景，最后在石舫收束由静到阔的游览。
summary_en: Start with Suzhou Street, contrast intimate garden scenes with palace courtyards, then move into broad lakeside views and finish at the Marble Boat.
highlights: 园中园与庭院尺度对比
长廊到石舫的湖岸过渡
tips: 后湖及部分院落有台阶、水岸高差和较窄通道，雨后注意脚下；苏州街经营、入内游览与票务条件以现场为准。
tips_en: Expect steps, waterside level changes and narrow passages in parts of the Back Lake area. Take care after rain and check local access and ticket conditions.
stops: 苏州街
观察桥、水、街和铺面如何形成水镇场景。
See how bridges, water, streets and shopfronts create a waterside town scene.
谐趣园
比较小桥、亭廊与水面的近距离构景。
Compare intimate compositions of bridges, pavilions and water.
乐寿堂
从较私密的庭院过渡到皇家生活区。
Move from intimate garden scenes into royal residential courtyards.
长廊
在廊道中观察视线怎样不断转向湖面。
Notice how the gallery repeatedly opens views toward the lake.
石舫
以临水建筑和开阔水面结束观察。
Finish by comparing a waterside building with the open lake.

name: 皇家建筑登高线
audience: 古建筑爱好者、体力较好的游客
audience_en: Architecture enthusiasts comfortable with a sustained hill walk
summary: 沿东部宫廷、长廊和前山中轴逐层展开，比较院落、殿堂与楼阁的空间变化，兼顾建筑细读与登高远眺。
summary_en: Trace a progression from palace courtyards through the Long Corridor to the front-hill axis, combining architectural observation with elevated views.
highlights: 佛香阁登高与后段园景
tips: 包含连续台阶与登高段，建议按体力安排停留，不适合追求少走路的行程；可通过调整路线跳过登高景点，开放及登临条件以现场为准。
tips_en: This route includes sustained steps and climbing. Adjust stops to your stamina; use itinerary adjustments to skip the ascent if necessary, and check on-site access.
stops: 仁寿殿
从理政院落理解皇家建筑的秩序感。
Read spatial order in the administrative courtyard.
乐寿堂
比较生活院落与理政院落的尺度和陈设。
Compare the scale and furnishings of residential and administrative courtyards.
长廊
观察廊柱、梁枋与湖山构景的关系。
Study columns and beams in relation to framed landscape views.
排云殿
沿门、院、殿的递进辨认建筑中轴。
Follow the sequence of gates, courtyards and halls along the axis.
佛香阁
从不同高度比较楼阁、台基与湖面关系。
Compare the tower, platform and lake from changing elevations.
谐趣园
以小尺度园中园对比前山的大尺度建筑。
Contrast an intimate garden with the monumental front-hill architecture.

name: 西堤桥影慢游线
audience: 湖景爱好者、愿意长距离慢走的游客
audience_en: Lake-view enthusiasts comfortable with a longer, unhurried walk
summary: 沿长廊与西侧湖岸展开，以石舫、玉带桥和桥岛为连续观察对象，适合把时间留给水面、桥景和岸边停留。
summary_en: Take an extended waterfront walk from the gallery toward the Marble Boat, Jade Belt Bridge and island, leaving time for bridges, water and shore-side pauses.
tips: “慢游”指观察节奏，并不代表步行距离短。西堤与东岸之间步行较长，应预留休息；本方案按步道计算，不包含游船捷径，南湖岛需原桥返回。
tips_en: Unhurried does not mean short: allow breaks for the longer transfer between western and eastern shores. Distances follow footpaths and exclude boat shortcuts. Return from the island over the same bridge.
stops: 长廊
先认识湖岸与万寿山的整体关系。
Begin with the overall relationship between lakeshore and hill.
石舫
停看船形建筑与沿岸视角的变化。
Pause to study the boat-shaped building from shore-side viewpoints.
玉带桥
比较高拱、堤岸与水面倒影的轮廓。
Compare the outlines of the high arch, causeway and reflections.
铜牛
回到东岸，以铜牛为观察湖山的前景。
On the eastern shore, use the ox as foreground for lake and hill views.
十七孔桥
沿桥感受桥孔、栏杆与开阔水面的节奏。
Observe the rhythm of arches, balustrades and open water.
南湖岛
从岛岸回望万寿山，停留后返回桥岸。
Look back toward Longevity Hill before returning across the bridge.

name: 宫廷生活细读线
audience: 偏好人文故事、希望减少登高的游客
audience_en: Visitors who prefer court stories and less climbing
summary: 围绕理政、戏曲、起居与日常生活深入游览东部宫廷区，再到长廊对照园林中的休憩与赏景活动。
summary_en: Explore government, theatre and residential life in the eastern palace area before contrasting formal courtyards with leisure along the gallery.
highlights: 理政、观演、起居三种功能
从宫廷秩序走入湖岸园林
highlights_en: From court order to garden leisure
tips: 路线重点在建筑功能与院落观察，资料中的人物活动要区分历史时期；殿内开放、演出与票务并非本路线承诺内容，请查看现场说明。
tips_en: Focus on building functions and courtyard observation, distinguishing different historical periods. Interior access, performances and tickets are not guaranteed by this plan.
stops: 仁寿殿
梳理理政与接见功能，观察殿前空间。
Explore administrative and reception functions through the forecourt.
德和园
理解宫廷戏曲与观演空间的关系。
Explore how court theatre related to its audience spaces.
玉澜堂
从院落、窗棂与通道观察居住空间。
Study residential space through courtyards, latticework and passages.
乐寿堂
比较居住、陈设与临湖园景的联系。
Compare residential furnishings with the adjoining lakeside garden.
长廊
以彩画和廊外湖景结束宫廷生活主题。
Finish with painted scenes and the lake beyond the gallery.

name: 东岸湖光精华线
audience: 半日游客、首次到访且偏好湖岸取景的人群
audience_en: Half-day visitors and first-timers interested in eastern-shore views
summary: 从东部宫廷空间转入文昌阁与铜牛湖岸，再经十七孔桥抵达南湖岛，把建筑、地标与开阔湖景连成一段完整体验。
summary_en: Move from the eastern palace area past Wenchang Pavilion and the Bronze Ox, then cross the Seventeen-Arch Bridge for island and lake views.
tips: 南湖岛没有在本方案中假定额外出口，游览后需返回十七孔桥；桥上风较大或人多时不要停留堵路，湖岸拍摄请与水边保持安全距离。
tips_en: The island is not treated as an extra park exit: return across the bridge after visiting. Avoid blocking the bridge and keep a safe distance from the waterfront.
stops: 仁寿殿
以宫廷理政建筑建立游园的历史背景。
Begin with royal administrative architecture as historical context.
文昌阁
观察城式楼阁与东岸岸线的关系。
Observe how the fortified pavilion relates to the eastern shoreline.
铜牛
以湖岸地标引入皇家园林的水景主题。
Use this shore-side landmark to explore the role of water in the garden.
十七孔桥
比较桥孔节奏、石雕细节与开阔水景。
Compare the rhythm of arches, carved details and open lake views.
南湖岛
从岛岸回望万寿山与前山建筑。
Look across the lake toward Longevity Hill and its architecture.
